family: Fixed total uniform NP family of proof.md: adcf87c0's affine-disperser evaluator with stretched sampler walk, plus a PXG terminal AGHP variant and a block-count-first base with fresh terminal condenser and hash; actualL=floor(log2 n), zero branch for n<2; constants as in proof.md; H=7412884525208893.
theorem: For every sufficiently large integer actual n, one fixed total eligible uniform NP family has unrestricted full-B2 complexity >= 4n-K*log2(n) with K=4H=29651538100835572 and no additive constant; joint projection (4,1).
